_readme: Single source of truth for exam patterns. Edit here, then run: node tools/series-import.js patterns > build/patterns.sql and run that file in Supabase. Section keys: id, s=subject, nm=name, t=type (MCQ single | MULTI multiple-correct | NUM numerical), n=number of questions, c=marks if correct, w=marks if wrong (negative number or 0), p=marks per correct option when partly right (MULTI only; default 0 = no partial credit). Questions of a test are stored in this exact order, section after section.
_verify: Targets: NEET (UG) 2027, JEE (Main) 2027 (January session), JEE (Advanced) 2027. Patterns follow publicly reported formats and are NOT yet confirmed by the agencies (JEE Main: 75 Q / 300 marks, Section B numerical marking and attempt rules have been reported inconsistently; NEET: 180 compulsory Q / 720 marks, duration unconfirmed; JEE Advanced: indicative, changes every year). Check each against the official NTA / JEE Advanced information bulletin once released and edit the numbers here if they differ.
